extDescription.message: Sends your own Street Fighter 6 matches from Buckler's Boot Camp to your SST account. Never sends your Capcom cookies or credentials.

pairHelpQuestion.message: Where do I get the code?

pairHelpAnswer.message: In SST, open the dashboard and press “Connect Companion”.

state_unpaired_body.message: Connect this browser to your SST account to start syncing your matches.

state_tracker_revoked_body.message: This device's connection to SST is no longer valid. Get a new code in SST to connect it again.

state_tracker_error_body.message: The Companion can't talk to SST right now. If the server was asleep, it can take up to a minute to start.

state_needs_cfn_body.message: SST doesn't have a CFN for this connection yet. Enter your CFN ID to get started.

state_needs_buckler_body.message: SST is connected. Next, let's check that Buckler's Boot Camp can read your profile.

state_needs_buckler_tab_body.message: We couldn't find an open Buckler's Boot Camp tab. Open it in this browser and try again.

state_needs_buckler_login_body.message: SST is connected, but Buckler needs you to be signed in with your Capcom account.

state_buckler_paused_body.message: Buckler temporarily refused requests. SST will wait before trying again.

state_buckler_paused_note.message: You don't need to reconnect the Companion.

state_buckler_error_body.message: We couldn't reach Buckler right now. SST will try again automatically.

state_ready_active_body.message: SST is following your session. Buckler is connected and automatic sync is on.

state_ready_idle_body.message: Buckler is connected and SST syncs your matches automatically.

sessionIdleGuidance.message: The Companion stays connected. Start a session in SST whenever you're ready to play.

readyClosing.message: You can play. SST takes care of the rest.

privacyTitle.message: Your Capcom session stays in this browser

privacyBody.message: SST never receives your Capcom password, cookies or credentials.

errGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Try again in a few seconds.

errTrackerUnreachable.message: We couldn't reach SST. On the first visit of the day the server can take up to a minute to start: open SST, wait for it to load and try again.

errOriginNotAllowed.message: This Companion build can't connect to that SST server.

errInvalidCode.message: Invalid or expired connection code. Get a new one in SST.

errRateLimited.message: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.

errCfnRequired.message: Enter your CFN ID first (or register it in SST).

errInvalidCfn.message: A CFN ID is a 6–12 digit number.

testReasonLogin.message: Sign in to Buckler's Boot Camp in this browser and test again.

testReasonRateLimited.message: Buckler rate-limited requests (429). Wait a few minutes.

testReasonTab.message: Open a Buckler's Boot Camp tab and test again.
